note: Custom breadcrumbs defines breadcrumb trails as custom_breadcrumbs config entities (custom_breadcrumbs.custom_breadcrumbs.<id>) matched either by content entity (type=1, via entityType+entityBundle+language) or by URL path pattern (type=2, via pathPattern). Each crumb's URL and title come from the newline-separated breadcrumbPaths/breadcrumbTitles textareas (paired by line index), with Token replacement and special syntax <front>, <nolink>, <term_hierarchy:field_name>. A high-priority BreadcrumbBuilder (service custom_breadcrumbs.breadcrumb, priority 1003) applies them. Global settings live in the custom_breadcrumbs.settings config object (home, home_link, current_page, current_page_link, trim_title, admin_pages_disable, site_wide) at route custom_breadcrumbs.config (/admin/config/user-interface/custom-breadcrumbs). Entities managed at /admin/structure/custom-breadcrumbs. Requires the token module; single permission administer custom_breadcrumbs. Medium/hard cases create/read real custom_breadcrumbs entities (prefixed cb_) and the settings object, verified against live config.

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal Custom breadcrumbs module let you do, and how is a single breadcrumb trail defined/matched?
evals.expected_output: It lets you define breadcrumb trails as custom_breadcrumbs config entities, each matched either by content entity type/bundle (type 1) or by a URL path pattern (type 2), with each crumb's URL and title built from text or Token replacement.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal Custom breadcrumbs module, what special placeholder syntax can I put in a breadcrumb path line to (a) make a crumb with no link and (b) expand a taxonomy term's parent hierarchy?
evals.expected_output: Use <nolink> for a crumb with no link, and <term_hierarchy:field_name> to expand a taxonomy term reference field into its full parent-to-child hierarchy. <front> links to the front page. Titles/paths also support Token replacement.

evals.prompt: Where are the global Custom breadcrumbs settings (like showing a Home crumb or disabling on admin pages) configured, and what is the settings config object name?
evals.expected_output: At /admin/config/user-interface/custom-breadcrumbs (route custom_breadcrumbs.config), stored in the custom_breadcrumbs.settings config object (keys home, home_link, current_page, current_page_link, trim_title, admin_pages_disable, site_wide).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a Custom breadcrumbs definition with machine name 'cb_known' that matches by URL path. Inspect the live configuration and state the path pattern it matches.
evals.expected_output: It matches /cb-known/* : custom_breadcrumbs.custom_breadcrumbs.cb_known has type 2 (path) with pathPattern /cb-known/*.

evals.prompt: This site has customized the label of the leading 'Home' breadcrumb crumb produced by the Custom breadcrumbs module. Inspect the live configuration and state the configured Home crumb label.
evals.expected_output: The Home crumb label is 'Start': custom_breadcrumbs.settings -> home_link = Start.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use the Custom breadcrumbs module to create a path-based breadcrumb definition with machine name 'cb_task' that applies to URLs matching /cb-task/* and shows a 'Tasks' crumb linking to /cb-task. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create config entity custom_breadcrumbs.custom_breadcrumbs.cb_task with type: 2, pathPattern: /cb-task/*, breadcrumbPaths: /cb-task, breadcrumbTitles: Tasks, status: true (e.g. CustomBreadcrumbs::create([...])->save()).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use the Custom breadcrumbs module to create a content-entity breadcrumb definition with machine name 'cb_task2' that applies to Article nodes (node / article) and shows a 'Blog' crumb followed by the node title. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create config entity custom_breadcrumbs.custom_breadcrumbs.cb_task2 with type: 1, entityType: node, entityBundle: article, breadcrumbPaths (e.g. "/blog\n<nolink>") and breadcrumbTitles (e.g. "Blog\n[node:title]"), status: true.
